# PMA Psykiatrisk Klinik

PMA Psykiatrisk Klinik is a clinical unit reported on in the Danish ADHD-databasen (ADHD database) for 2024, appearing in the results tables for two of the database's quality indicators covering adult ADHD treatment courses [^src1][^src2]. On Indicator 10 — which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of treatment start — the clinic achieved only 43% (confidence interval 33–54), based on 42 of 97 eligible cases, and was marked "Nej" (No) for meeting the standard [^src1]. This result falls well short of the national quality goal of 90% [^src1]. Indicator 10 was reported for the first time in the 2024 database, and the clinic's shortfall echoes a broader national pattern: nationally only 37% of treatment courses met the standard, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52%, prompting the database's steering group to discuss registration practices and data quality, particularly from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, as contributing causes [^src1].

By contrast, on Indicator 11 — which tracks whether adult patients are in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a package course of treatment — PMA Psykiatrisk Klinik performed much better, reaching 85% (confidence interval 76–91) based on 82 of 97 cases [^src2]. Indicator 11 was also being measured for the first time for adults, following the 2024 expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients [^src2]. Regional results for this indicator varied widely nationally, from 85% in Region Nordjylland to 37% in Region Hovedstaden, a gap the underlying documentation attributes primarily to differences in registration practice rather than genuine differences in clinical care [^src2].

Taken together, the two results position PMA Psykiatrisk Klinik as a clinic that met one new 2024 quality benchmark reasonably well (Indicator 11) while falling significantly below target on another (Indicator 10), mirroring the uneven rollout of these newly introduced measures across Danish psychiatric services [^src1][^src2].
